family_fixing.statement: The v4 roster (37) is frozen and copied byte-identically. The three additions and their themes are the v4.2 revision R1' (declared 2026-09-27 after the v4 gate failed, disclosed in the prereg with the aggregate v4, v4.1 and T26 book results). Each takes the canonical definition of its cited paper within the prereg parameters; the implementer read no v3/v4 per-candidate TRAIN performance output (admission statistics, daily IC files) and no validation data. Disclosed: res_mom_12_1 is byte-identical to the v2/v3 candidate resid_sharpe_12_1_s21, whose TRAIN statistics the controller may have seen; its definition follows Blitz-Huij-Martens under the lookback bound, not a v2/v3 result.
family_fixing.v4_statement: Roster, themes, member ids and signs are prereg R1 (declared 2026-09-27 before any v4 TRAIN read), with the fix-round-1 and fix-round-2 rulings (iv_change, mgmt_sy and qmj_lite dropped; canonical droe), also before any v4 TRAIN read. Each member takes the canonical definition of its cited paper (window, scaling, exclusion rule) and the s21 default; the implementer read no v3 TRAIN performance output (admission tables, daily IC, summary IC statistics, v3 DSL catalogue) and no validation data. Field names come from the T18 section 6 proposal and the fields-v4 manifest field list (names and units only). Disclosed (prereg R1): v3 per-candidate TRAIN statistics were seen by the controller for price/volume families; the PV, SI, IV and EAR definitions here follow the literature, not v3 results.

templates.domain: non-positive book equity -> NaN (Fama-French)
non-positive earnings -> NaN (excluded), as in Hou, Xue and Zhang (2020)
non-positive cash flow -> NaN (excluded), as in Hou, Xue and Zhang (2020)
templates.deviation: LSV cash flow is earnings plus depreciation; reported operating cash flow is used
negative free cash flow kept (ranks lowest)

templates.base_dsl: (((oi_ttm / ((me_company + debt) - che)) + (0 * log(oi_ttm))) + (0 * log(((me_company + debt) - che))))
templates.domain: non-positive EBIT or enterprise value -> NaN (negative multiples excluded, Loughran-Wellman)
templates.deviation: EBIT (operating income) replaces EBITDA: no depreciation field; debt follows the T20 zero-fill rule
net issuers (negative yield) kept

templates.domain: non-positive sales -> NaN (excluded), as in Hou, Xue and Zhang (2020)
zero or unreported R&D -> NaN (R&D-reporting firms only, as in Chan-Lakonishok-Sougiannis)
non-positive total assets -> NaN (house guard)
non-positive book equity -> NaN
templates.deviation: operating income stands in for revenue - COGS - SG&A - interest

templates.domain: non-positive average total assets -> NaN (house guard)
templates.deviation: reported operating cash flow proxies cash-based operating profitability (no R&D add-back)

templates.domain: non-positive opening book equity -> NaN
non-positive total assets -> NaN (house guard)
templates.deviation: trailing-twelve-month earnings over current assets (no one-quarter-lagged assets field)

templates.domain: non-positive average total assets -> NaN (house guard)
non-positive lagged total assets -> NaN (house guard)
non-positive lagged total assets -> NaN (house guard)
non-positive share ratio -> NaN (log)
templates.deviation: weighted-average diluted (else basic) shares of the anchor quarter (else fiscal year), not period-end shares outstanding. Split consistency by the T20 contract: facts are keyed by (start, end) and a later clock overrides, so shrs_q_lag4 is the anchor filing's own prior-year comparative, which the filing presents (Reg S-X 10-01(c); ASC 260 EPS denominators for every period presented) restated retroactively for splits (ASC 260-10-55-12). No price-factor correction is applied: it would double-correct that restated pair. A filer that does not re-report the comparative leaves the pair split-contaminated; T25 checks known splitters (AAPL 2020-08, TSLA 2020-08 and 2022-08, NVDA 2021-07, AMZN 2022-06, GOOGL 2022-07)

templates.formula: log(adj / adj[t-252]) with adj = shares_out * raw_close / close: log growth of line market equity minus the log total return
templates.base_dsl: (-1 * log((((shares_out * raw_close) / close) / delay(((shares_out * raw_close) / close), 252))))
templates.domain: non-positive ratio -> NaN (log)
templates.deviation: shares_out and raw_close share the session basis, so splits and consolidations cancel; the dividend-adjusted close makes dividends count as payout (Daniel-Titman composite issuance, not the Pontiff-Woodgate share count); the vendor share count lags 90 days (A8)

templates.formula: sue (producer: seasonal random walk on first-reported quarterly net income)
templates.deviation: filing clock (10-Q/10-K acceptance + 1 session), not the announcement date; net income, not EPS

templates.domain: non-positive opening book equity in either quarter -> NaN
non-positive lagged total assets -> NaN (house guard)

templates.formula: market-adjusted return over the 3 sessions [r-1, r+1] around the most recent vendor reaction session r, recorded at r+1 and carried until the next announcement, at most 126 sessions
templates.domain: NaN on non-event sessions before the carry (0 * log(0)); NaN when no announcement in 126 sessions
templates.deviation: Chan-Jegadeesh-Lakonishok measure the abnormal return around the most recent quarterly announcement and hold six months, hence a six-month carry cap (one missed quarter keeps the name); the 3-day [-1, +1] window is the prereg choice (Brandt et al.; CJL, as recalled, use days -2..+1); equal-weight member market return (mkt_ret) as the benchmark
equal-weight FF49 industry mean (Moskowitz-Grinblatt: value-weight, 20 industries)
adjusted close (split and dividend continuous) in both terms
correlation window 250 sessions (Frazzini-Pedersen: 5 years; the runner bounds lookback at 314); equal-weight member market; no Vasicek shrink (rank-invariant)

templates.formula: sd(ret, 21) * sqrt(|1 - corr(ret, mkt_ret, 21)^2|): market-model residual volatility, one month
templates.base_dsl: (-1 * (stddev(((close / delay(close, 1)) - 1), 21) * signedpower(abs((1 - (correlation(((close / delay(close, 1)) - 1), mkt_ret, 21) * correlation(((close / delay(close, 1)) - 1), mkt_ret, 21)))), 0.5)))
templates.deviation: market model residual (the paper uses Fama-French three-factor residuals; it reports CAPM robustness)

templates.formula: sd(ret, 252) minus its FF12 industry mean

templates.deviation: si_shares is on the FINRA settlement-date share basis and shares_out on the session basis: from a split until the next dissemination the ratio is off by the split factor (v3 caveat)
FINRA computes days to cover on one basis (short interest over average daily volume): no split mismatch

templates.formula: si_ratio - si_ratio[t-21] (one month, two FINRA cycles)
templates.deviation: Rapach-Ringgenberg-Zhou is an aggregate time-series result; the cross-sectional change is the pre-registered extrapolation; si_shares is on the FINRA settlement-date share basis and shares_out on the session basis: from a split until the next dissemination the ratio is off by the split factor (v3 caveat), so a split gives a spike and an opposite-signed echo 21 sessions later

templates.formula: close / close[t-5] - 1 minus its FF49 mean
templates.deviation: weekly industry-adjusted return; the s21 decay spreads it over about a month (the papers use one month)

templates.formula: close[t-224] / close[t-245] - 1: the 21-session window whose s21-decayed centre (t-241.2) matches the centre (t-241) of the same 21 sessions one year before the next 21
templates.deviation: annual lag 12 only (lags 24+ exceed the 314-bar bound); the window is shifted 7 sessions later than the undecayed [t-252, t-231] because the s21 linear decay moves the effective centre 6.7 sessions earlier (mean lag of weights 21..1 = 1540 / 231)

templates.domain: v3 IV guard
templates.deviation: implied minus realized (the negative of the paper's realized-minus-implied spread)

templates.formula: sum over t-251..t-21 of (ret - beta * mkt_ret) / sd of the market-model residual over the same window; beta = OLS slope of ret on mkt_ret over that window
templates.base_dsl: delay(((ts_sum(((close / delay(close, 1)) - 1), 231) - (ts_regression(((close / delay(close, 1)) - 1), mkt_ret, 231) * ts_sum(mkt_ret, 231))) / (stddev(((close / delay(close, 1)) - 1), 231) * signedpower(abs((1 - (correlation(((close / delay(close, 1)) - 1), mkt_ret, 231) * correlation(((close / delay(close, 1)) - 1), mkt_ret, 231)))), 0.5))), 21)
templates.deviation: market model on the equal-weight member market (the paper: Fama-French three factors) and betas estimated on the formation window itself (the paper: the prior 36 months, beyond the 314-bar bound); with an in-window fit the intercept is kept (sum of ret - beta * mkt = n * alpha), so the score is the standardized formation-window alpha. Byte-identical to the base of the v2 template resid_sharpe_12_1

templates.formula: 1 when the last vendor reaction session r satisfies r + 63 in [t+1, t+21] (marker r+1 in [t-61, t-41] and no later marker), else 0; NaN without an announcement in the last 126 sessions
templates.domain: NaN when no announcement in the last 126 sessions (no schedule to predict from)
templates.deviation: expected date = last announcement + 63 sessions (prereg R1'; the papers predict from the announcement of the same quarter a year earlier, as recalled). Built only from past earn_recent reaction flags: the vendor's own upcoming-event flag (earnFlag -1) is mapped to 0 by the producer and is not used, so the prediction is causal. The long leg holds through the reaction session and the day after, then leaves at r_next + 1
templates.smoothing_reason: the premium accrues in the window up to and around the predicted announcement; the base switches off at the announcement, and a 21-session linear decay would keep the name long for about 20 sessions after it, where the cited papers find no premium

templates.formula: mean over 126 sessions of volume / shares_out
templates.domain: non-positive shares_out -> NaN
templates.deviation: volume and the vendor shares_out are both on the session's share basis, so a split cancels; shares_out lags 90 days (A8); window 126 sessions (prereg R1'; the paper averages three months of monthly turnover, as recalled)

fields.name: close
fields.basis: role adjusted close (split and dividend continuous)

fields.name: raw_close
fields.basis: role raw close (unadjusted)

fields.name: volume
fields.basis: role raw share volume

fields.name: mkt_ret
fields.basis: equal-weight mean adjusted close-to-close return (close[d] / close[d-1] - 1) over the previous session's (d-1) as-of members, broadcast to every name present at d; produced upstream

fields.name: si_shares
fields.basis: FINRA consolidated shares short (currentShortPositionQuantity); as-of: latest row with available_at strictly before date(session), NaN when older than 45 calendar days

fields.name: si_dtc
fields.basis: FINRA days to cover (daysToCoverQuantity, floored at 1.00 by FINRA); as si_shares

fields.name: iv_atm_21d
fields.basis: vendor ATM implied volatility, annualized decimal, 21-session constant maturity; producer domain [0.02, 5] else NaN; candidates also apply the v3 guard

fields.name: earn_recent
fields.basis: indicator: 1 on the vendor earnings price-reaction session (earnFlag 0) and the session after (earnFlag 1), 0 otherwise; NaN when the vendor row is absent

fields.name: shares_out
fields.basis: vendor shares outstanding of the last line row dated <= date(session) - 90 calendar days (A8 lag), restated to the session share basis

fields.name: be
fields.basis: book equity at the anchor period_end A: stockholders equity (else equity including minority interest minus minority interest) minus preferred stock, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: at
fields.basis: total assets at A, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: at_lag4
fields.basis: total assets at the balance date nearest A - 365 d, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: che
fields.basis: cash and short-term investments at A, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: debt
fields.basis: short-term plus long-term debt at A, each zero-filled (flagged) when absent while assets exist, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: sale_ttm
fields.basis: revenue, trailing twelve months ending at A, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: gp_ttm
fields.basis: gross profit (else revenue minus cost of revenue), trailing twelve months, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: oi_ttm
fields.basis: operating income (EBIT), trailing twelve months, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: ni_ttm
fields.basis: net income, trailing twelve months, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: ni_q
fields.basis: net income of the fiscal quarter ending at A, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: ni_q_lag4
fields.basis: net income of the fiscal quarter ending near A - 365 d, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: be_lag1q
fields.basis: book equity at the balance date nearest A - 91 d (opening equity of the quarter), USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: be_lag1q_lag4
fields.basis: book equity at the balance date nearest A - 456 d (opening equity of the quarter one year earlier), USD; added in fix round 1; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: cfo_ttm
fields.basis: net cash from operating activities, trailing twelve months, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: capx_ttm
fields.basis: capital expenditure (payments for PP&E, positive), trailing twelve months, USD; NaN when not reported; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: xrd_ttm
fields.basis: research and development expense, trailing twelve months, USD; NaN when not reported; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: dvc_ttm
fields.basis: common dividends paid, trailing twelve months, USD; zero-filled (flagged) when absent; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: prstkc_ttm
fields.basis: purchases of common stock (buybacks), trailing twelve months, USD; zero-filled (flagged) when absent; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: sstk_ttm
fields.basis: proceeds from issuance of common stock, trailing twelve months, USD; zero-filled (flagged) when absent; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: txt_q
fields.basis: income tax expense of the fiscal quarter ending at A, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: txt_q_lag4
fields.basis: income tax expense of the fiscal quarter ending near A - 365 d, USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: shrs_q
fields.basis: weighted-average diluted shares (else basic) of the fiscal quarter ending at A (else the fiscal year ending at A), shares; as reported, split-restated by the reporting filing; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: shrs_q_lag4
fields.basis: the same concept and duration class ending near A - 365 d, as known at the row clock (latest filing reporting that period, so the anchor filing's split-restated comparative); the pair is NaN when abs(log10 ratio) >= 2 (XBRL scale error); planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: noa
fields.basis: net operating assets at A: at - che - lt + debt (Hirshleifer, Hou, Teoh and Zhang 2004), USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: sue
fields.basis: standardized unexpected earnings of the quarter ending at A: seasonal random walk on first-reported quarterly net income, (NI_q - NI_q-4) / sd of the previous <= 8 seasonal differences (>= 4 required); planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: fscore
fields.basis: Piotroski (2000) F-score 0-9 at A, all nine signals required, producer-computed; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: me_company
fields.basis: company market equity: sum over the issuer's role lines of shares_out x raw_close (NaN if any linked line is NaN), USD; planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: grp_ff12
fields.basis: Fama-French 12-industry code of the latest visible SUB SIC (T21 grp group); planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

fields.name: grp_ff49
fields.basis: Fama-French 49-industry code of the latest visible SUB SIC (T21 grp group); planned fields-v5 name (T18 section 6, produced by T21); the producer manifest is authoritative

field_clocks.grp_ff12: T21: latest visible FSDS SUB SIC event, 550-day staleness -> NaN; NaN label excluded from group statistics
field_clocks.grp_ff49: T21: latest visible FSDS SUB SIC event, 550-day staleness -> NaN; NaN label excluded from group statistics

requires.fields_v5: T21 fields-v5 manifest with every declared name (runner refuses a declared extra absent from the manifest)
requires.t22: grp_* typed as Group by typecheck is_group_field (T22; landed at root)

data.causality: row d of a signal uses fields known by the session-d close mark and is scored against returns after d; fundamentals add the declared 1-session lag; si_* are strictly before date(d); shares_out lags 90 days
data.domain_guard: x + 0 * log(d) makes x NaN unless d > 0 (log(0) = -inf, 0 * -inf = NaN)
data.realized_vol: stddev(ret, 21) * 15.874507866387544 (sqrt 252), annualized decimal like the IV field
data.earnings_window: event = earn_recent * delay(earn_recent, 1) is 1 on r+1 (reaction r and r+1 flagged); ts_sum(excess, 3) at r+1 spans r-1..r+1
data.eap_window: event = earn_recent * delay(earn_recent, 1) marks r+1; long iff a marker in [t-61, t-41] and none in [t-40, t]; NaN iff no marker in [t-125, t]
data.share_turnover: volume / shares_out per session (same share basis), mean over 126 sessions

admission.policy: v4-prior-v2 (T27; prereg v4.2 R3': v4-prior-v1 plus reject standalone TRAIN tau_k > 0.08, status reject_turnover_cost)

composition.theme_weight: 1/9 per theme with >= 1 admitted member, split equally among admitted members; renormalised over themes present
composition.runner_default: equal family weight = equal theme weight (family is theme)

trials.reruns: v4 admission attempts remain prior trials of the 37

static_validation.rule: python re-parse (v2/v3 validator lineage + dtype rule): canonical round-trip, registry arity, declared fields, Group classifier only as a group operator's 2nd argument, positive integer windows, lookback recomputed per typecheck, dag slot bound; v4.2 adds registry rows sign, ts_mean, ts_regression (cross-checked against registry.cpp)
static_validation.slot_estimate: post-order interning and refcount retirement; native --plan-only authoritative

qualification.low_turnover: smoothing intent; tau_k measured at admission (<= 0.70)
qualification.prior_phase: v1-v4 files and generators are unchanged by v4.2
